name: AXM Game Forge
summary: One game-development workspace with a shared 2D Physics Lab, instant map preview, reviewed package building, modular runtimes, multiplayer lobby and play-test flow.
notes: Game Forge v1.2 consumes AXM Physics 2D v0.3.1 for paused-by-default experiments, explicit project snapshots, contact lifecycle with preserved sensor truth, collision filtering, contact-aware sleep/wake including moving supports, bounded persistent-contact evidence, permanent canaries, adversarial fixtures, a promoted spatial-hash broadphase for new worlds, opt-in accumulated-impulse warm starting with explicit diagnostics, live diagnostics and bounded replay-trace export. Existing worlds keep warm starting disabled unless they explicitly request it; v0.2 world documents without broadphase metadata retain the all-pairs reference path. It does not claim scientific validation, rigid-body rotation, joints, fluids, deformables, universal broadphase pruning, universal warm-start improvement or general 3D physics. Existing Game Hub runtimes, four-seat lobby, QR controllers, package verifier and Studio asset handoff remain the execution path.
